label: Bible Study
prompt: _____, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD:
verse: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD:
note: The Shema — Israel's great confession, recited daily for millennia, and quoted by Jesus as the first commandment.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And he said unto me, It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life _____.
verse: And he said unto me, It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.
note: The water of life is offered freely — no price tag for the thirsty.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a _____, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.
verse: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.
note: Moses lifted a serpent of brass on a pole — the very image Jesus later applied to himself in John 3.

label: Deep Water
prompt: They which builded on the wall, and they that bare burdens, with those that laded, every one with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other hand held a _____.
verse: They which builded on the wall, and they that bare burdens, with those that laded, every one with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other hand held a weapon.
note: Rebuilding Jerusalem's wall under threat: a trowel in one hand, a weapon in the other.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him _____, smitten of God, and afflicted.
verse: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.
note: He carried our griefs, yet we thought him 'stricken, smitten of God' — the great misreading of the Servant's suffering.
